name: FullscreenVS.hlsl

name: LightingCommon.hlsli
summary: Shared HLSL lighting library for shadows, hemisphere ambient, classic lights, toon bands, height fog, and Cook-Torrance PBR.
languageNotes: Include header with fixed cbuffer registers b2/b3 and comparison-sampler PCF cascades.

name: ParticlePS.hlsl
summary: Particle pixel shader that multiplies atlas texture and instance color, then clips near-zero alpha.

name: ParticleVS.hlsl
summary: Instanced particle vertex shader that billboards quads in view space with per-instance size, UV rect, and rotation.

name: PixelShader2D.hlsl
summary: 2D sprite pixel shader that multiplies sampled texture, vertex color, and a color constant buffer.

name: PixelShader3D.hlsl
summary: Default lit 3D pixel shader that loops all lights, applies CSM shadows, hemisphere ambient, emission, and height fog.

name: PixelShader3D_DirectionalPixel.hlsl
summary: Lit 3D pixel shader variant that evaluates only directional lights with shadows, ambient, and height fog.

name: PixelShader3D_Hemisphere.hlsl
summary: Unshadowed 3D pixel shader that outputs hemisphere ambient plus emission and height fog.

name: PixelShader3D_Outline.hlsl
summary: Solid-color outline pixel shader that writes MaterialBuffer OutlineColor for inverted-hull passes.

name: SampleBaseColor
summary: Samples the albedo texture when enabled and multiplies vertex plus material diffuse into RGB and alpha.

name: CotangentFrame
summary: Builds a cotangent-frame TBN matrix from position and UV derivatives so normal maps work without mesh tangents.

name: ApplyNormalMap
summary: Perturbs the interpolated object-space normal with the tangent-space normal map scaled by NormalStrength.

name: PCF3x3
summary: Averages a 3x3 percentage-closer filter using a comparison sampler for soft shadow edges.

name: SampleCascadeShadow0
summary: Projects a receiver into cascade 0 light space and returns a biased PCF shadow factor.

name: SampleCascadeShadow1
summary: Projects a receiver into cascade 1 light space and returns a biased PCF shadow factor.

name: SampleCascadeShadow2
summary: Projects a receiver into cascade 2 light space and returns a biased PCF shadow factor.

name: SampleCascadeShadow3
summary: Projects a receiver into cascade 3 light space and returns a biased PCF shadow factor.

name: EvalShadow
summary: Selects a CSM cascade from view-space depth for directional lights and blends adjacent maps near split planes.

name: EvalHemisphereAmbient
summary: Lerps sky and ground ambient by normal Y and adds a downward ground-bounce term from Ambient.a.

name: EvalDirectionalLight
summary: Computes Lambert diffuse plus optional Blinn-Phong specular for a directional light.

name: EvalPointLight
summary: Evaluates a point light with quadratic attenuation, optional range fade, and optional specular.

name: EvalSpotLight
summary: Evaluates a spot light with distance attenuation and an inner/outer cosine cone falloff.

name: QuantizeToon
summary: Bands a 0-1 lighting factor into discrete toon steps with optional smoothstep edges.

name: EvalPointDiffuse
summary: Returns attenuated Lambert intensity for a point light without a specular term.

name: EvalSpotDiffuse
summary: Returns cone-attenuated Lambert intensity for a spot light without a specular term.

name: EvalCelSpecular
summary: Hard-steps Blinn-Phong specular past SpecularThreshold for cel highlights across light types.

name: ApplyHeightFog
summary: Mixes lit color toward FogColor using camera distance and a world-height falloff when fog is enabled.

name: EvalLightFacingRim
summary: Computes a Fresnel rim weighted away from the key directional light for a backlit anime edge.

name: EvalCookTorrance
summary: Cook-Torrance BRDF using GGX NDF, Schlick-Smith geometry, and Schlick Fresnel with energy-conserving diffuse.

name: EvalPointPBR
summary: Feeds a range-attenuated point-light direction into the shared Cook-Torrance evaluator.

name: EvalSpotPBR
summary: Feeds a cone-attenuated spot-light direction into the shared Cook-Torrance evaluator.

name: main
summary: Builds clip-space positions and UVs for a covering triangle from the vertex ID.

name: main
summary: Samples the particle atlas, clips low alpha, and returns tinted premultiplied color.

name: main
summary: Rotates the local quad, expands it along camera right/up, and applies the instance UV rectangle.

name: main
summary: Returns texture * vertex color * g_Color for 2D sprites.

name: main
summary: Accumulates directional, spot, and point lighting with per-light shadows, then applies fog and a shadow overlay.

name: main
summary: Loops lights but shades only directional entries, combining Lambert+specular, shadows, and fog.

name: main
summary: Samples base color, applies the normal map, and writes hemisphere ambient plus emission.

name: main
summary: Writes the material outline color as the fragment output.

name: PixelShader3D_PBR.hlsl
summary: Cook-Torrance PBR pixel shader that lights all types with roughness/metallic and a Fresnel-boosted ambient term.
languageNotes: Stays in the engine gamma path and does not apply an extra tone-map or gamma encode.

name: PixelShader3D_PointPixel.hlsl
summary: Lit 3D pixel shader variant that evaluates only point lights plus a dim ambient and height fog.

name: PixelShader3D_Rim.hlsl
summary: Rim-light pixel shader that adds a light-facing Fresnel edge on top of dim hemisphere ambient.

name: PixelShader3D_SpotPixel.hlsl
summary: Lit 3D pixel shader variant that evaluates only spot lights with shadows, overlay, and height fog.

name: PixelShader3D_SurfaceFX.hlsl
summary: Parametric dual-scroll surface shader for water, lava, or energy with radial depth gradient and edge fade.

name: PixelShader3D_Toon.hlsl
summary: Cel-shaded 3D pixel shader with quantized bands, optional ramp texture, cel specular, and a light-facing rim.

name: PixelShaderUnlit.hlsl
summary: Unlit textured pixel shader that clips near-zero alpha and multiplies sampled color by vertex color.

name: PostProcessPS.hlsl
summary: Fullscreen post-process pixel shader stacking mosaic, RGB split, contrast, posterize, grain, vignette, scanlines, and flicker.

name: ShaderCommon.hlsli
summary: Shared HLSL constants for WVP, 128-bone skinning, and the material buffer used by 3D vertex and pixel shaders.
languageNotes: Header-guarded include; Diffuse.a doubles as a texture-enable flag.

name: SkyboxPS.hlsl
summary: Skybox pixel shader that samples a cubemap along the view direction and applies tint plus exposure.

name: SkyboxVS.hlsl
summary: Skybox vertex shader that rotates the cube, projects with z=w so the sky stays at the far plane.

name: VertexShader2D.hlsl
summary: 2D vertex shader that transforms local positions by a world matrix and a combined view-projection matrix.

name: main
summary: Samples material maps, boosts ambient by Schlick Fresnel, and accumulates shadowed Cook-Torrance lighting.

name: main
summary: Loops lights and adds only point-light contributions plus ambient, emission, and fog.

name: main
summary: Adds a specular-tinted light-facing rim on dim hemisphere ambient, then applies height fog.

name: main
summary: Loops lights and shades only spot entries with shadows, overlay, emission, and fog.

name: main
summary: Scrolls two world-XZ UVs, lerps shallow/deep colors by radius, and fades alpha at the mesh edge.

name: main
summary: Accumulates shadowed Lambert, quantizes to toon bands or a ramp, then adds cel specular and rim.

name: main
summary: Samples the bound texture, clips low alpha, and multiplies by interpolated vertex color.

name: MosaicUV
summary: Snaps local UVs to a block grid when mosaic block count is greater than one.

name: SampleRGBShift
summary: Samples red and blue with opposing radial offsets to produce a chromatic-aberration split.

name: main
summary: Applies the configured post stack to the scene texture, including optional flicker from a time hash.

name: SkinPositionOS
summary: Linear-blend skins an object-space position by up to four bone matrices when skinning is enabled.

name: main
summary: Normalizes the interpolated direction and samples the cubemap with tint and exposure.

name: main
summary: Rotates the skybox vertex, projects it, and writes clip.xyww so depth stays at the far plane.

name: main
summary: Multiplies local position by world * projection and forwards color plus texcoord.

name: VertexShader3D.hlsl
summary: Standard 3D vertex shader that projects object-space positions through WorldViewProjection and forwards lighting interpolants.
languageNotes: HLSL entry point includes ShaderCommon.hlsli for shared matrices and helpers.

name: VertexShader3DSkinned.hlsl
summary: Skinned 3D vertex shader that blends bone-weighted positions with SkinPositionOS before the WorldViewProjection transform.

name: VertexShader3D_Outline.hlsl
summary: Outline-pass vertex shader that skins a mesh then extrudes clip-space XY along the projected normal for a screen-consistent toon silhouette.

name: VertexShaderUnlit.hlsl
summary: Billboard and ground-decal vertex shader that builds camera-facing or XZ-aligned quads with rotation, atlas UVs, and per-instance color.
